intro: Deliver Thomas' Report carries grim intelligence from eastern Elwynn Forest back to Goldshire's garrison command. Guard Thomas charges an adventurer with alerting Marshal Dughan to the deaths of two guards and the uncontrollable expansion of local murloc tribes. The report highlights how precariously thin Stormwind's military presence is across its own heartland.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.
I know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm, this news is troubling. Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.
If things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
